findings.evidence: `Module.Projective.of_split` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Projective.lean:164) asks for `s.comp i = LinearMap.id`; `ext` only applies `LinearMap.ext`/`Subtype.ext`, so the composite application is reduced by `exact`'s defeq check, not by any rewrite.
findings.fix: Close it robustly, e.g. `simp [p, mul_assoc, he.eq]` (or `simpa [p, mul_assoc] using he.eq`), so the step does not depend on those definitional unfoldings.
findings.issue: `exact (mul_assoc a e e).trans (congrArg (a * ·) he.eq)` has type `a * e * e = a * e`, while the goal after `ext ⟨x, hx⟩` is a coercion of `(p.comp (Ideal.span {e}).subtype) ⟨a*e, hx⟩`; it closes only by unfolding `LinearMap.comp`, `LinearMap.codRestrict`, `LinearMap.mulRight`, `Submodule.subtype` and the subtype coercion, with no comment saying so.

findings.evidence: `IsCoatom.le_iff_eq (ha : IsCoatom a) (hb : b ≠ ⊤) : a ≤ b ↔ b = a` at mathlib/Mathlib/Order/Atoms.lean:199; `LinearMap.isCoatom_ker_of_surjective` at mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/SimpleModule/Basic.lean:507 gives `IsCoatom (ker f)`, hence `ne_top`.
findings.fix: Replace lines 132-136 with the direct term: `exact (h.isCoatom_jacobson_smul_top.le_iff_eq (LinearMap.isCoatom_ker_of_surjective hf).ne_top).mp hle`.
findings.issue: `ker_eq_jacobson_smul_top_of_surjective` reaches the equality via `le_antisymm` + `by_contra` + `lt_of_le_of_ne` + `IsCoatom.2`, reinventing existing coatom API and obscuring the one-step reason.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/Algebra/Module/ProjectiveCover/Existence.lean:137-139 is the same argument: `Module.Projective.of_split (LinearMap.range e).subtype (e.codRestrict ...) (LinearMap.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (hfix _ x.2))`; no Mathlib lemma covers it (grep for `IsIdempotentElem.*[Pp]rojective` in ./mathlib returns nothing).
findings.fix: Extract one lemma (e.g. `LinearMap.IsIdempotentElem.projective_range : IsIdempotentElem f → Module.Projective R (LinearMap.range f)` for `[Module.Projective R M]`), derive `projective_span_singleton` from it plus `LinearMap.range (mulRight A e) = Ideal.span {e}`, and use it at the existing site.
findings.issue: The reusable fact behind `projective_span_singleton` — a summand cut out by an idempotent projection of a projective module is projective — is now proved twice in-repo with the same `of_split`/`codRestrict` boilerplate instead of once.

summary: Proofs are short and mostly robust, but one new lemma closes its goal by unfolding four wrappers with an undocumented `exact`, one proof reinvents `IsCoatom.le_iff_eq` with a `by_contra` detour, and the summand-projectivity argument is now written twice in the repo instead of being factored out.
